note: Per-vehicle install recipes, fetched by the app at runtime (never hardcoded in the APK). installerPackage = the installer identity to attribute the install to (adb -i); reinstall = -r; allowDowngrade = -d; grantAll = grant every runtime permission after install (-g).
factoryCodeNote: Only these vehicles need the head-unit factory code (dev_adb_auth_passwd) written during Factory Pass. For any other vehicle the server returns no factory_code and the app writes nothing. Kept here (server-side) so the list is never baked into the APK.
